sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed with grievance that the petitioner, who is having a valid license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 for working as a whole-seller, distributor, retailer of meat, is not being permitted to carry on his business.
The petitioner has accordingly prayed for a direction to the respondent to decide his representation filed in this behalf.

2. Learned Standing Counsel has placed on record the instructions from District Magistrate,
Firozabad in which it is admitted that the petitioner's firm was granted License No.
12724002000047 dated 16.1.2025 by the Central Licensing Authority, New Delhi and the said license is valid upto 13.3.2026.

It is stated that on the representation of the petitioner dated 29.3.2025 and upon the recommendation of the Nagar Ayukt, vide order dated 15.4.2025, an order Anshar Quraishi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 24 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163269301/
1 has been issued by the District Magistrate on 30.4.2025 directing SHOs' of various police stations not to interfere in the working of persons having valid licenses.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner admits that since after filing of the writ petition, there has been no obstruction in carrying on of business by the petitioner.
4.

5. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
